escalation_queue.reason: System rejected repair ticket creation despite caller confirmation
escalation_queue.handover_summary: Priya Shah, T-1003, verified. Oven door hinge broken, door won't open or close. Routine repair. Access: weekday mornings, has a cat. Caller says landlord PRE-APPROVED a replacement oven up to £650; she asks us to order ApplianceDirect model at £649 instead of repairing. Caller confirmed details but system rejected ticket creation.
